Actual cognitive realization and societal correspondence remain open. The conceptual corrigibility integration adds no proof; normative reasons, execution protocols and local maintenance do not constitute a full solution. A further 38 theorems / 61 audits cover entrenchment despite obedience, harmful unrestricted task optima, costly constrained correction and joint exit capacity; motivation, actual burdens and legitimate authority remain explicit obligations.
